description: Assainissement - Vidangeurs agréés - Département du Calvados is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département du Calvados. Census of approved drainers in the Department of Calvados with indication of the type of drain carried out, its volume and its end date of validity. Collection context Since 2002, the Department of Calvados has operated a geographical information system, responsible, among other things, for updating vector data concerning its territory. Coverage: Département du Calvados. The portal shows the English title as "Sanitation - Approved Vidangeurs - Department of Calvados" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Département du Calvados. Its keywords include station-depuration, assainissement, epandage, eau-usee, vidange. The listing shows 2 download or service links in ZIP, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2024-11-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
